entities.name: St. Mary Magdalene Church, Wrocław
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Cathedral of St. Mary Magdalene in Wrocław, Poland, is a gothic church located between Szewska and Łaciarska street close to the central market square, established in the 13th century. It serves as a cathedral of the Polish Catholic Church led by Piotr Mikołajczak. Along with the Old Town of Wrocław, it is listed as a Historic Monument of Poland.
